(Draft) Findings - Demo - Penetration Testing 01-26.... What to edit/change via automation:

Customer Name: set name

IP Address: extract information from Technical Report under Engagement Scope of Work

Logistics: set start and end date and contact

Narrative, Host Discovery: extract information from Technical Report under Penetration Test Narrative, Host Discovery

Narrative, Host Discovery: include "Internal Network Assessment"

Narrative, Exploitation: set customer name

Findings Summary, Executive Overview (edit/modify graphs): extract information from Technical Report under Discovered Threats

***Assessment Results Summary [HIGH PRIORITY] (pick 5 max from category, fit to only 1 page): extract information from Executive Report under Engagement Results Summary, Internal Network Penetration Test

***Finding Details [HIGH PRIORITY]: extract information from Technical Report under corresponding status such as Critical, High, Medium, and Low -> title, combination of Observation and Security Impact for description, then risk, impact, affected nodes table (screenshot), and evidence (screenshot)

Informational: extract information from Technical Report (more screenshots)

***Automated Testing Activity [HIGH PRIORITY]: extract information from Activity Report under Activity Log, Internal Network Penetration Test

***Recommendations, Discretionary Remediation [HIGH PRIORITY]: extract information from Technical Report under Recommendation (not necessarily a direct copy/paste) also have to Refer to Finding Severity #

Appendix (fit to only 1 page): extract information from Technical Report under Appendix B: Host Discovery (Opened Ports) -> (screenshot)
